requiredBehaviors: different users or tenants never share account registries
foreign account ids are rejected by main process
automatic scheduling only uses authorized candidates
legacy placeholder accounts migrate only when the current tenant has a matching browser profile
the generic task IPC can create drafts only
retrying a legacy task filters foreign account candidates before persisting the child task
renderer never scans another tenant localStorage key
tenant switching invalidates the old execution context
disposing the old orchestrator releases account locks and rejects later writes
tenant switching aborts the old agent lifecycle and destroys old embedded browser sessions
removing an account is blocked while active tasks are bound and closes the account browser session before registry deletion
